replacementContract.source: scripts/assets/farm_props/export_farm_props.mjs (verifyContract); every rule below is enforced there, per asset, on raw and optimized GLBs
replacementContract.scene: exactly one scene; its only child is the contract rootNode at identity (translation [0,0,0], rotation [0,0,0,1], scale [1,1,1], tolerance 1e-8)
replacementContract.boundsYd: min [-footprintX/2, 0, -footprintZ/2], max [footprintX/2, heightYd, footprintZ/2]; tolerance 1e-5 raw, 3e-3 optimized
replacementContract.meshes: mesh node names exactly equal the contract mesh set; each mesh carries exactly one primitive, mode TRIANGLES, attributes exactly COLOR_0 + NORMAL + POSITION; the crop_accent material binds to the CropAccent mesh and to nothing else
replacementContract.materials: material names exactly equal the contract material set
replacementContract.forbidden: no textures, no animations, no skins, no cameras
replacementContract.extensions: optimized GLBs use and require exactly EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization; Draco is forbidden; raw exports carry no extensions
replacementContract.sockets: every Socket_* node is an empty mount point (no mesh, no children) carrying extras.farmPropSocket.purpose equal to the contract purpose string, seated at 0 < y <= heightYd
replacementContract.stampedExtras: the root node carries extras.farmPropContract equal to its FARM_PROP_CONTRACTS row and extras.sculptRuntime with the asset id and swapReady true; extras.sourceFingerprint is stamped at BOTH sites (document root extras and asset extras) and must match scripts/assets/farm_props/source_fingerprint.mjs
replacementContract.determinism: the optimizer must rebuild byte-identically (the exporter compares a candidate and a repeat run per asset, then the shipped file against the candidate)

renderIdentity.note: hex values are written as 0x-prefixed sRGB strings for readability; the renderer multiplies them into the shared materials at draw time
renderIdentity.channelUse: As consumed by src/render/farm_patches.ts: soil is the bed whole-mesh multiply, wood is the compost bin whole-mesh multiply; trim is authored for a future higher-tier trim pass and has no draw-time consumer today.

WET_SOIL_DARKEN.note: multiplied into the bed biome soil tint on the non-accent stage parts

adapterParameters.feastShadowNote: shadow casting sheds at the cap (the first 8 tables in insertion order cast; the budget refills as feasts despawn) but feast PRESENCE is never culled: every table in interest scope draws at every graphics tier
adapterParameters.compostBinNote: yd west of the bed grid west edge, on the first row line, short of the 5 yd bed pitch so the bin never lands where a future bed row would
